name: Alchemer
description_en:
Alchemer Survey is a questionnaire creation, distribution and analysis product within a broader feedback platform. It supports custom branding, logic, varied question types and reporting. The surrounding platform also includes other collection, integration and intelligence products; their presence in navigation does not put every capability into an individual survey license.

The meaningful purchase distinction is between individual/small-team survey tiers and a custom Business Platform agreement. Research question types and deeper analysis belong to higher tiers. This profile evaluates those documented boundaries, not vendor claims of faster launch or improved retention.
description_zh:
Alchemer Survey 是更广反馈平台中的问卷创建、分发与分析产品，支持品牌、逻辑、多种题型和报表。周边平台还包括其他收集、集成及情报产品；出现在导航里不代表每种能力都属于个人问卷许可。

采购关键区别是个人／小团队问卷档与定制 Business Platform 协议。研究题型及更深分析属于较高档。本文研究这些文档边界，不采纳厂商关于更快上线或提高留存的效果主张。

core_features.explanation_en: Build a tailored questionnaire with branching and branding options.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过分支与品牌选项构建定制问卷。

core_features.explanation_en: Full Access adds advanced research question types and statistical/reporting tools.
core_features.explanation_zh: Full Access 增加高级研究题型及统计／报表工具。

core_features.explanation_en: Survey pages describe email, links, SMS and QR distribution; entitlements need checking.
core_features.explanation_zh: 产品页描述邮件、链接、短信与二维码分发，权益需核对。

use_cases.basis: Editorial task and fit judgments grounded in the attached primary sources; no observed deployment.

Research scope.en: Public documentation and commercial access reviewed; examples are proposed evaluation workflows.

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.
target_audience.organization_sizes_zh: 按流程、用量与治理需求选择，不宣称适合所有规模。

steps.en: List the exact question types, exports, seats and response volume before selecting a tier. Pilot representative answers and confirm where contact identifiers appear in shared reports. This is hosted survey software; no self-hosted distribution or source license was verified. Organizations needing cross-channel workflows should separately scope the Business Platform.
steps.zh: 选择档位前列清具体题型、导出、席位和回答量。用代表性答案试点，确认共享报表中哪些地方出现联系人标识。这是托管问卷软件，未核实自托管发行或源代码许可。需要跨渠道工作流的组织应单独确定 Business Platform 范围。

items.en: A candidate for structured business surveys and progressively deeper research, Alchemer does not remove sampling bias or establish causal impact from a score trend. Check monthly capacity, file limits and failed-invitation behavior in your account. Security badges are not a signed agreement for a specific dataset. Integration retries, retention, export fidelity and the exact availability of AI follow-up functionality were not tested.
items.zh: 它可用于结构化业务问卷及逐步深入的研究，但不能消除抽样偏差，也不能从分数趋势直接建立因果效果。应在账户内核对月度容量、文件限制及邀请失败行为。安全徽章不是针对具体数据集签署的协议。集成重试、保留、导出保真和 AI 追问的具体可用性未测试。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The current USD page lists monthly/user prices of $55 Collaborator, $165 Professional and $275 Full Access. Annual/user totals are $315, $1,075 and $1,895. The respective annual response allowances are 75,000, 100,000 and 125,000 per account, based on the highest license; monthly limits also apply. Professional and Full Access list a maximum of three users. Platform plans require a quote. Free trials or POCs are offered, but no enduring free plan or exact trial duration was established here.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前美元页列每用户月费：Collaborator 55 美元、Professional 165 美元、Full Access 275 美元；每用户年费分别为 315、1,075、1,895 美元。对应年度回答额度为每账户 75,000、100,000、125,000，依据最高许可计算，另有月度限制。Professional 和 Full Access 列最多三人。平台方案询价。提供免费试用或 POC，但本次未建立持续免费档或确切试用时长。

sections.title_en: Design a service study with a tested branch
sections.title_zh: 设计带已测试分支的服务研究
sections.en: For a proposed support survey, ask whether the issue was resolved and show a relevant follow-up. Test both routes before sharing and inspect a known response in the report. Define how a low score should reach an owner; do not assume a survey license includes the entire automation platform. A generated AI questionnaire is an editable starting point whose wording and population still need review.
sections.zh: 以支持问卷为例，先问问题是否解决，再显示相应追问。分享前测试两条路径，并在报表检查已知回答。定义低分由谁接收，不能假定问卷许可包含整套自动化平台。AI 生成问卷只是可编辑起点，措辞和调查总体仍需审核。
